title: Claude Code · Ops
description: Latency, cache efficiency, tool reliability, MCP health, cost per repo/model, hooks and permission modes. Streams: claude_code (logs + traces), claude_code_cost_usage (metrics).

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 2) AS y FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'api_request'
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cache_read_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens), 0), 1) AS y FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'api_request'
SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.5) / 1000.0, 2) AS y FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name = 'claude_code.llm_request' AND TRY_CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE) > 0
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(success AS VARCHAR) = 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS y FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'tool_result'

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS t, approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.5) AS p50, approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.95) AS p95 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name = 'claude_code.llm_request' AND TRY_CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE) > 0 GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS t, approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.5) AS p50, approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.95) AS p95 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name = 'claude_code.llm_request' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Where the time goes (s): model vs tools vs waiting on you

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS t, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user' THEN TRY_CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0 AS waiting, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'claude_code.tool.execution' THEN TRY_CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0 AS executing, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'claude_code.llm_request' THEN TRY_CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0 AS model FROM "claude_code" GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Tool calls and failures by tool

queries.query: SELECT tool_name, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(success AS VARCHAR) = 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(success AS VARCHAR) = 'false' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS ok FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'tool_result' GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY ok + failed DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT tool_name, approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.95) AS p95 FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'tool_result' GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY p95 DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS t, model, SUM(cost_usd) AS usd FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'api_request' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS t, SUM(input_tokens) AS input, SUM(output_tokens) AS output, SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read, SUM(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_write FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'api_request' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT COALESCE(vcs_repository_name, '(no repo)') AS repo, SUM(value) AS usd FROM "claude_code_cost_usage" GROUP BY repo ORDER BY usd DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Cost by entry point and version (USD)

queries.query: SELECT COALESCE(app_entrypoint, '(unknown)') AS entrypoint, COALESCE(app_version, '(unknown)') AS version, ROUND(SUM(value), 2) AS usd FROM "claude_code_cost_usage" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY usd DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS t, status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'mcp_server_connection' GROUP BY t, status ORDER BY t

SELECT COALESCE(server_name, mcp_server_name, '(redacted)') AS server, transport_type, COUNT(*) AS failures, MAX(error_code) AS last_error_code FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'mcp_server_connection' AND status = 'failed' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS t, event_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name IN ('api_error', 'api_retries_exhausted', 'api_refusal') GROUP BY t, event_name ORDER BY t
SELECT COALESCE(stop_reason, '(none)') AS stop_reason, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name = 'claude_code.llm_request' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT hook_event, approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(total_duration_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.95) AS p95, COUNT(*) AS runs FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'hook_execution_complete' GROUP BY hook_event ORDER BY p95 DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT to_mode, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name = 'permission_mode_changed' GROUP BY to_mode ORDER BY n DESC
